root.label: Federal Reserve eases discount window and standing repo access

events.label: Federal Reserve eases discount window and standing repo access

slots.name: disruption date
slots.sentence: Cutting supply first risks repeating the money-market disruptions of September 2019 , when the Fed misjudged how many reserves banks actually needed and shrank the balance sheet too far.

slots.name: facility access status
slots.sentence: Reducing banks’ need to pre-fund any obligations can go faster, as moves to ease access to the Fed’s discount window and its backstop lending tool (the standing repo facility) are already underway .
